The organization directly operating **FlashAI** (`flashai.me`) is **UNKNOWN**. 

Official sources, including the product website and its Chrome Web Store listing, do not identify a registered corporate entity or operating company. On the Chrome Web Store, the extension is listed as offered by an individual non-trader developer under the account name `flash.ai1996`.
